# Review region evidence

Synthetic stress content for the region-grouping cockpit plan. Its only job is to make dense regions, stale evidence, open actions and unsourced conclusions visible in the public demo.

frontmatter.attention_basis: Dense evidence needs a human review.
frontmatter.next_action: Review the region evidence and record the result.
